title: Know Before You Fetch: When Does Confidence-Based Retrieval-Budget Allocation Pay Off?
abstract: arXiv:2606.29959v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adaptive retrieval-augmented generation uses a signal from the reader, such as its confidence when answering without retrieval (closed-book), to decide whether and how much to retrieve. We compare such methods not with always retrieving many passages but with the best simple policy under the same cap on average passages per query: a fixed depth or a random mixture of fixed depths. Policies allocate zero, one or five passages and are scored on held-out questions. Seven settings of about 2,000 questions combine TriviaQA, Natural Questions and MS MARCO, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B readers, and two retrieval sources: per-question passage pools and a 3.5-million-passage Wikipedia index. Allocation by confidence could gain in three ways. It rations a scarce budget: at a cap of half a passage per query it beats the best simple policy in all seven settings, by 0.010 to 0.075 in accuracy. translated_title: 先知而后取：基于置信度的检索预算分配何时才有收益？
translated_abstract: 自适应检索增强生成利用阅读器的信号（例如其在无检索的“闭卷”作答时的置信度）来决定是否检索以及检索多少。我们不是将这些方法与总是检索大量段落的做法相比，而是在每查询平均段落数相同上限的约束下，与最佳的简单策略进行比较：固定深度检索或固定深度的随机混合。各策略分配零个、一个或五个段落，并在保留问题集上进行评分。七个约含2,000个问题的实验设置组合了TriviaQA、Natural Questions与MS MARCO数据集、Qwen3-8B与Qwen3-32B阅读器，以及两种检索源：按问题的段落池和350万段落的维基百科索引。基于置信度的分配可能从三个方面获益。它能配给稀缺的预算：在每查询平均半个段落的上限下，它在全部七个设置中都优于最佳简单策略，准确率提升0.010至0.075。它能避免有害检索：在单个段落的上限下……
tldr: 该研究在相同的每查询平均检索预算上限下，将基于阅读器置信度的自适应检索分配与最佳简单策略（固定深度或其随机混合）对比，发现置信度分配在极紧预算（每查询平均半个段落）下于全部七个设置中稳定胜出（准确率提升0.010–0.075），其价值在于配给稀缺预算和避免有害检索。
en_tdlr: Under the same average retrieval-budget cap, confidence-based adaptive retrieval allocation outperforms the best simple policy (fixed depth or a random mixture of fixed depths) in all seven settings at very tight budgets (half a passage per query, +0.010–0.075 accuracy), with its payoff coming from rationing scarce budgets and avoiding harmful retrieval.
